title: How to Find 10% of Any Number Instantly
description: The decimal-point trick that makes finding 10% of any number almost instant — useful for tips, discounts, and everyday math.
narration_lines: Finding 10% of a number is instant.
10% means one tenth, so divide by 10. 350 divided by 10.
That's the same as moving the decimal one place left.

steps.label: 10% means one tenth of the number
Just move the decimal one place left
